## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the final change and its scope, including migration/data implications.

## Verification

List relevant canonical commands and actual results. Identify skipped/unrun checks
and unresolved failures. Do not claim hosted CI evidence from local runs.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Existing work preserved; manifest/docs updated where needed.
- [ ] Fictional fixtures only; no credentials, personal resumes, cookies, raw
  transcripts, databases or token-bearing URLs in code, screenshots or logs.
- [ ] Owned resources stopped/cleaned; existing development data untouched.
- [ ] Prior permission for code changes obtained under RIGHTS.md; no extra rights granted here.
- [ ] Dependency and release limitations remain accurately stated.

Do not disclose sensitive vulnerabilities here. See SECURITY.md; the private
security-reporting channel remains unconfigured.
